name: Full Site Function and Tool Audit
purpose: Validate every public HTML surface, local route, linked asset, JavaScript syntax contract, JSON feed, download route, form surface and critical interactive tool before Cloudflare deployment.
hardFailureRules: Missing critical page, script or data feed
Broken local target on a critical page
Fragile Geographic Power Atlas runtime restored
warningRules: Form without an obvious submit control or JavaScript hook
Noncritical script fetch target requiring manual review
boundary: Static and postbuild audits validate the shipped site bundle. Authenticated transactions, PayPal sandbox behavior, email delivery, D1 writes and third-party services also require live environment checks.
